question: Does the receipt-profile inspector agree with execution of the pinned official NEAR SDK transfer resolver in an owned local mocked environment?
phases: Provision an isolated official Rust toolchain without changing user/system defaults; preserve exact compiler version and lockfile.
Inspect source/build scripts, then run externally authored fungible-token unit tests on an unchanged pinned checkout; preserve full output and source integrity.
Implement a separate owned harness calling the actual unmodified resolver against mocked host state and promise result bytes.

Compare original SDK return values, ledger deltas and emitted event strings with the current frozen inspector through an explicitly constructed receipt adapter. Preserve every first result and disagreement before fixes.

hookResult: JSON number rather than U128 string
negativeControls: gross cap below original transfer despite refund
minimum settlement above actual non-refunded non-burned allocation
evidenceControls: actual SDK event strings preserved exactly
changed original log text cannot silently keep the old exact-input report

failureCriteria: Any disagreement between supported known inspector payment amounts and SDK ledger-derived refund/burn/return value is a defect or an explicitly unsupported profile; it cannot be omitted to improve counts.
A registered permitted fully evidenced payment cannot be labelled breached merely because it shares a price or uses an allowed refund.
Incomplete causal evidence cannot be promoted to exact settlement.
Upstream test/build failure is recorded as failure, not independent evidence of correctness.
limits: SDK mock-host execution is not a NEAR network transaction, a deployed-WASM run, consensus authentication or an agent execution.
Our parameter choices, receipt adapter and grading remain same-author and source-informed. External implementation authorship does not make the complete study an independent blind evaluation.
No new model, paid API, RPC, wallet, mainnet, registration, message or financial transaction is permitted.
timestampNote: Initial manually typed future timestamp corrected to filesystem creation/write time before SDK execution.
